links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of spine patient-education materials before vs after ChatGPT-4o revision to sixth-grade level
links.effect: Original PEMs mean FKGL 10.2 ± 2.6; ChatGPT-4o revisions mean FKGL 6.6 ± 1.3 (p < 0.05); SMOG, language complexity, and passive voice also improved.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o generated articles with a significantly reduced mean FKGL of 6.6 ± 1.3 (p < 0.05).

links.outcome: Readability of patient education materials after AI plain-language rewriting versus originals
links.effect: Mean FKGL fell from 10.2 ± 2.6 to 6.6 ± 1.3 (p < 0.05) while reportedly maintaining accuracy and adequate detail; test-retest ICC 0.91 to 0.98.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o demonstrated the potential to enhance PEM readability while maintaining content quality.
